items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Yeah we lost some. Yup. We had some in May, nice concerts, a couple of nice concerts we were supposed to do in May in Florida.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean it’s very weird because when you commit to a gig and sign a contract, you know, you never want to cancel. It never feels right. I think a lot of the work in the fall, they’re all European musicians. You know one’s from France and the other two are in Germany. It’s just a matter — well even that, that’s a border to cross from France to Germany. I don’t know if the musician there would be able to make it, and I have basically said to them, “If I can’t make it, just find a sub for me.” “Yes, but you…
Do you have booked gigs with Rossano and Eddie?

Yeah we lost some. Yup. We had some in May, nice concerts, a couple of nice concerts we were supposed to do in May in Florida. A couple of jazz parties and hopefully December in Bern, Switzerland. We’ll see if Marians in Bern is opened up. That’s a beautiful club. I hope that happens.
